runtime_license_boundary.detail: The strict MIT/Apache-2.0 Cargo package audits and selected-source guards pass without exceptions. The known futures-channel BSD queue was replaced by an original synchronized FIFO. Bundled OpenSSL now excludes the separately noticed SipHash implementation through no-siphash and no-quic; the old binary and failed single-option build are rejected by the exclusion gate. Current static core 88c03d90 passed 31 container and 29 HTTPS checks. It still contains non-allowlisted Rust Unicode data, while libc, unwind, compiler-builtins and startup inputs remain incompletely reviewed. Combined-option GNU candidate e02164b6 passed startup, numerical, TLS, native compilation capture, mapped-source and compiler-notice checks; it has no retained SipHash symbols or objects. Earlier external-TLS GNU candidate 2df83ea9 passed 31 container and 29 HTTPS checks on separate runtime infrastructure. Both use external std with non-allowlisted components that must not be bundled. Individual-file exceptions, unmapped or inlined content, external-runtime distribution and production adoption remain uncleared. See licensing.md and runtime-link-audit.md.

jellyfin_12_behavior.detail: 106 of 364 operation declarations match; this does not measure compatible behavior. Current core 88c03d90 passed 31 container and 29 HTTPS checks, including active FFmpeg shutdown and video resume after restart. Both official web and Qt 6 Desktop completed the three-track original FLAC mix with automatic advancement, eleven successful playback responses per client and exactly one added play per track without a state reset. Web active audio and Desktop audio EOF were observed. The client-backend upgrade preserved grants, identity, media state, playlists and favorites. Twenty-four public studio requests, favorite persistence and both official studio views passed on preceding core 3f06f4ac. Its native short-video playback failed in MPV video-output initialization, a Direct3D control stalled, and several fresh OpenGL controls stayed blank, including a complete kit in a short path. Those failures remain preserved. Earlier client observations retain their exact image scopes in acceptance.md. Public Jellyfin 12 observations support studio filename precedence, stored folder sorting, music state, and artist-role/count behavior. Embedded tags, automatic artist creation, ambiguous names, complete recommendation and collection management, studio artwork and virtual enumeration, played-state writes and full Jellyfin 12 behavior remain incomplete. General Desktop startup, broader clients, native AAC, arbitrary seeking, audible quality and scale remain unvalidated. Native final-position inconsistency remains unexplained; some user-data writes retain qualified differences from the reference.

feature_acceptance.detail: Feature areas remain partial. See compatibility.md for individual limits.

external_client_and_remote_security.detail: 29 local HTTPS proxy checks passed with synthetic remote addresses. Internet deployment, broader external-client behavior, proxy configurations, and external security review remain incomplete.

operational_scale.detail: Bounded 20,000- and 99,000-file synthetic scanner runs passed. No real-storage 1 PB, billion-file, or thousand-stream load result is available.
